name: Hawaiian Discovery Furniture
old_description: Please click here & review shipping and delivery information prior to placing an order.
about:
Hawaiian Discovery Furniture operates from Honolulu, Hawaii. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The business retails indoor and outdoor furniture collections built around acacia and teak wood, including dining sets, lounge seating, bar sets, and accessories. It also offers a planter line made from a blend of Styrofoam, sand, coal, and cement. Hawaiian Discovery Furniture provides White Glove delivery and assembly service on the islands of Oahu and Maui, but does not currently offer assembly on the mainland or other neighbor islands. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The company serves homeowners and designers seeking Hawaiian-inspired furnishings for residential indoor and outdoor spaces. Its product range spans dining, lounge, and bar configurations in both acacia and premium teak, along with planters, umbrellas, outdoor rugs, and cushion covers. There is no indication of commercial or hospitality contracts in the provided material.

Hawaiian Discovery Furniture positions its pieces as 'inspired by & made for Hawaii,' emphasizing durability and low maintenance. The planter collection is marketed as eco-friendly, using reusable materials blended with cement for sustainability. Acacia wood is highlighted for its strength and generational longevity, while premium teak is promoted as lasting decades with minimal upkeep.

name: Haworth Headquarters and Showroom
old_description: Create connection with Moxie, a modular lounge system that turns ordinary spaces into destinations. It fits your people, your space, and your budget.
about:
Haworth operates its headquarters and showroom in Holland, Michigan, which serves as a center for product development and client engagement. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in the available public information.

The company manufactures a holistic office furniture portfolio that includes ergonomic chairs, modular workstation systems, architectural products such as movable walls and raised floors, ancillary furniture collections, and acoustic pods under the Hushoffice brand. Haworth works through a network of dealer partners to deliver and install these solutions globally.

Haworth serves higher education institutions, healthcare facilities, government agencies at the state, local, and federal levels, and corporate clients across technology and other sectors. Notable projects include a pilot space for video game developer UbiSoft, a LEED-certified building for Honeywell, and a hybrid-work redesign for software company Softchoice.

The company emphasizes a design-forward approach and workplace expertise, stating that it defines industry standards rather than following them. It highlights decades of experience with municipal projects and a long-standing partnership with the U.S. General Services Administration for federal and military buyers.

name: Health Korea Hawaii - Massage Chairs & Health Foods
old_description: H Solution Far-Infrared Half Sauna [HI, AK shipping fee is extra]
about:
Health Korea Hawaii operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, where it runs an online and retail operation specializing in Korean massage chairs and health foods. The company, doing business as Health Korea Shop, offers a curated selection of wellness products sourced from Korean brands such as H Solution and Chunho N Care. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

The product lineup centers on massage chairs—including the TROY, Gravity TURBO, KAIROS, DIVA, and Tini series—alongside foot and leg massagers, eye massagers, LED therapy masks, and a range of nutritional supplements such as psyllium husk powders, red ginseng extracts, and herbal juices. The company also carries robotic mopping cleaners and small appliances like steamers and scalp massagers. Services include white-glove delivery with basic assembly on request, phone ordering, and financing options. Free shipping is offered on orders over $60 within the contiguous United States, with additional fees for Hawaii and Alaska.

Health Korea Hawaii primarily serves individual consumers seeking Korean wellness and pain-relief solutions, including customers who use OTC or Flex benefit cards for eligible purchases. The Honolulu showroom provides a free massage chair experience, allowing shoppers to test models before buying. The company also markets to gift buyers and health-conscious households through seasonal promotions and bundle deals.

The business differentiates itself by focusing exclusively on Korean-engineered health devices and supplements, combined with a white-glove delivery service that includes setup and packaging removal. Acceptance of OTC and Flex cards expands accessibility for buyers with health savings accounts, while financing plans lower the barrier for higher-ticket items such as premium massage chairs.

name: Hear Technologies
old_description: PRO Connect provides a web-based interface to update, conﬁgure, and control your PRO Mixers and PRO Hubs.
about:
Hear Technologies is based in Huntsville, Alabama, where it designs and manufactures personal headphone monitoring systems for professional audio applications. The company develops hardware and software solutions that allow musicians and engineers to create custom monitor mixes in live and studio environments.

Its product line includes the Hear Back PRO system—comprising Hub and Mixer units—the Hear Back OCTO, Switch Back PLUS, Switch Back M8RX, Dante-WSG XS, and Mix Back devices. The Switch Back M8RX combines two functions in a single unit: zero-latency analog mixing of four inputs and Ethernet-based audio networking. The company also provides the PRO Connect web interface for configuring PRO Mixers and Hubs, along with iOS and Android apps for wireless control. Firmware updates and routing capabilities support up to 128 channels of audio per Hub.

Hear Technologies serves the professional audio, live sound, recording studio, touring, and education markets. Its systems have been used by artists such as Marc Broussard, Michael Thompson Band, and Snarky Puppy, as well as facilities including Mercy College, The NuttHouse Recording Studio, Esplanade Studios, and Ray Parker Jr. Studio. The company also partners with Waves SoundGrid for Dante network integration.

The company emphasizes intuitive design and robust capabilities, highlighting that the Switch Back M8RX is effectively two products in one, offering both analog mixing and Ethernet connectivity. Its PRO Connect platform aims to simplify device management through a browser-based interface, while the mobile apps enable remote mixer adjustments during performances.

name: Heartland Electronics Inc
old_description: Our job starts with you: understanding what you need, so we can offer you options that make sense.
about:
Heartland Electronics operates from a facility at 4150-C Ehlmann Road in St. Peters, Missouri, where it provides value-added processing services for wire, cable, and tubing. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials, and no founders are named on its website.

Its in-house capabilities center on four core services: Sumimark computerized marking and cutting of heat-shrinkable tubing to MIL-Spec SAE-AS-83519; respooling of wire and cable to customer-specified lengths under UL and CSA approval; cut-to-length processing for tubing, flat cable, and wire; and striping of hook-up wire with up to three stripes, also UL and CSA approved. The firm presents itself as a service-oriented operation rather than a product manufacturer, though no facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are published.

The company does not list specific industries or customer types on its website, focusing instead on the technical processes it performs. Its stated differentiation rests on a commitment to 'Quality Service and On-Time Delivery' and a consultative approach: 'Our job starts with you: understanding what you need, so we can offer you options that make sense.'

name: Heartland Food Products Group - Manufacturing Facility
old_description: Beyond our brands, we are the leading provider of private label sweeteners and liquid water enhancers in the U.S.
about:
Heartland Food Products Group traces its roots to October 1991, when Purdue graduate Ted Gelov launched a plastic packaging and novelties business in southern Indiana. The operation soon shifted to food-grade containers and co-packing for larger brands, laying the groundwork for a vertically integrated consumer packaged goods company. Today the firm is headquartered in Carmel, Indiana, with manufacturing facilities in Indianapolis, Indiana; Tultitlán, Mexico; and Amsterdam, Netherlands.

The company produces low-calorie sweeteners and liquid water enhancers under its own Splenda and Java House brands, while also serving as the U.S. private-label supplier in those categories. Its Indianapolis campus includes a 350,000-square-foot distribution center, a spray-dry plant with liquid blending, and an aseptic packaging line for shelf-stable protein shakes, ready-to-drink coffee, and creamers. A global workforce of over 1,200 supports R&D, market research, quality, creative design through the in-house agency The Workshop, manufacturing, distribution, and operations.

Heartland’s customers include retailers, foodservice operators, and brand owners across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific. The company cites strategic co-manufacturing partnerships with category leaders and notes that a senior manager at a global foodservice retailer praised its responsiveness and target-matching expertise.

The organization emphasizes “Fast, Flexible, Innovative” as cultural pillars, attributing its speed to vertical integration that enables ideation-to-shelf execution. Its stated mission is to help people live happier, healthier, and longer lives by making it easier to reduce sugar.

name: Heavy Metal Fabrication & Welding
old_description: Where precision meets strength. Mobile welding & custom metal fabrication experts ready to spark life into your project with professionalism and superior customer service.
about:
Heavy Metal Fabrication & Welding operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, where it was founded in 2021 by James Craft. The business began as a mobile welding service and has since expanded to two locations in the area, operating as a limited liability partnership.

The shop provides mobile welding and custom metal fabrication, including structural, MIG, and TIG welding performed on-site. Its fabrication work covers brackets, frames, gates, railings, and custom industrial components, while its repair and maintenance division handles trailers, equipment, and metal structures. The mobile team brings welding equipment directly to job sites across the region.

The company serves construction, agricultural, and industrial clients in and around Colorado Springs, with projects ranging from ornamental metalwork to structural repairs for heavy equipment and trailers. Customers include property owners, contractors, and operators needing on-site welding or custom-built metal components.

Craft, who brings over a decade of hands-on welding experience, established the business on a philosophy of showing up, doing excellent work, and treating every client with respect. The company emphasizes clear communication, adaptability to each project’s needs, and standing behind its workmanship.
